author: Author
console_ph: Type a whitelisted command… (doctor, backup create, route test…)
lore_lines: Clotho spins. Lachesis measures. Atropos decides.
The thread is cut only when the work is done.
Even the Fates cannot turn what Atropos has woven.
She who cannot be turned — that is the whole point.
Every thread is measured before it is cut.
The loom remembers what the hands forget.
Three sisters, one loom, no second chances.
Woven at dawn, cut at the appointed hour.
Do not fear the shears — fear the unmeasured thread.
What survives the cut is what was worth weaving.
A frayed strand today, a clean cut tomorrow.
The pattern is never random; the pattern is you.
lore_verdicts: The thread is sound. Nothing to cut.
A frayed strand. Shears at the ready — see above.
The weave is tearing. Cut it and re-weave: read the failures above.

lore_empty.mcp: No threads joined to the loom.
lore_empty.memory: The loom is silent. Weave a note.
lore_empty.activity: Nothing has happened yet. The Fates are resting.
lore_empty.fleet: No other boxes on the loom yet.

tips: Run `atropos doctor` after any redeploy — 7 checks, one command.
`atropos backup create` before risky work; restore with `atropos backup --restore`.
Press Ctrl+K in the dashboard to search every panel.
`atropos settings export` shows you everything, secrets masked.
Routers fail over nain → omni → local; you stay in control.
`atropos sync push` shares configs, never secrets.
The patch engine re-arms itself after every update.
Guest mode is the same engine with private context filtered out.
`atropos update --check` dry-runs before you commit to anything.
Type `?` in the REPL for help, `/doctor` to heal.
fate_lines: The threads hold. No cutting needed today.
Frayed strands ahead — backup before you weave.
The loom hums. Today is for finishing, not starting.
Three hands on one shuttle; mind the crossings.
A thin thread wants attention. Doctor it early.
The Fates are tidy today. Nothing dangling.
News will arrive by wire. Read it twice before acting.
One knot to undo, one to tie. Pick the order well.
The shears rest today. Let them.
Pattern repeats — yesterday's fix still holds.

lore_stories.default:
The three sisters sat at the loom while the machine slept.
Clotho wound the thread of intent; Lachesis measured what was asked;
Atropos watched the edges for what frayed.
When the machine woke it found nothing broken — only woven.
lore_stories.shears:
Atropos keeps the shears on a hook beside the loom.
Not for the thread — the thread is never the enemy.
They are for the knots that pretend to be thread.
She tests each knot twice. Once by hand, once by eye.
Then she cuts, and the loom never remembers the knot.
